We are dedicated to your 100% satisfaction. If you have any questions about your cloud couch or need any assistance, our friendly customer support team is just a message away.

products.title: Garvee Convertible Sleeper Sofa Bed, 78.8" Floor Sofa Bed, 5-in-1 Folding Mattress Couch Loveseat with Fixed-Shape Frame, Pillow, Corduroy Fabric for Living Room Bedroom Lounge, Dark Green

description.plain:
5-in-1 Comfort for Everyday Living

Designed for flexible spaces, this 78.8-inch convertible sleeper sofa combines everyday seating, relaxed lounging and a spacious sleeping surface in one versatile design. Soft corduroy upholstery, high-density foam and a reinforced support structure make it practical for living rooms, apartments, guest rooms and multipurpose spaces.

One Sofa, Multiple Ways to Relax

Adjust the convertible design to match the moment, from upright everyday seating to relaxed lounging and an expanded sleeper setup for overnight guests.

1 Everyday Sofa
2 Relaxed Lounge
3 Reclined Comfort
4 Guest Sleeper
5 Fully Expanded Bed

Spacious When You Need It

Keep the sofa compact for everyday use, then open it into a generous sleeping surface when guests stay overnight.

Sofa Mode
78.8"L × 39.4"W × 27.5"H
Bed Mode
78.8"L × 78.8"W × 19.6"H

Soft Corduroy Upholstery

Textured corduroy creates a warm, inviting look while providing a soft surface for everyday sitting, lounging and relaxing.

High-Density Foam

Supportive foam provides a firmer, more stable feel designed for both sitting and sleeping.

Up to 1200 lb Capacity

A reinforced stainless-steel support structure provides dependable stability for everyday use.

Designed for Real-Life Spaces

Practical details help this convertible sofa work in apartments, guest rooms and shared living spaces where furniture needs to serve more than one purpose.

78.8-inch wide convertible design
Soft dark green corduroy upholstery
High-density supportive foam
Reinforced stainless-steel support structure
Washable armrest organizers
Throw pillows and support pillows included
Non-slip base for added stability
Ideal for apartments, guest rooms and living rooms

Quick Setup After Delivery

The sofa arrives compressed for easier transportation. Unpack the components, connect the support sections according to the included instructions and allow approximately 48–72 hours for the foam and upholstery to recover their intended shape.

Minor compression marks or wrinkles after unpacking are normal and should gradually improve as the sofa expands.

What's Included

Washable Armrest Organizers × 2
Throw Pillows × 2
L-Shaped Support Pillows × 2
Stainless-Steel Support Frames × 2
Easy-Assembly Sofa Bases × 2
User Manual × 1

Care & Setup Tips

  1. Allow approximately 48–72 hours after unpacking for the compressed foam and upholstery to recover their intended shape.
  2. Gently pat and reshape the cushions after unpacking.
  3. Avoid prolonged exposure to strong direct sunlight to help reduce fading.
  4. Blot spills promptly with a soft, slightly damp cloth.
  5. Use mild, fabric-safe cleaners and avoid harsh chemicals.

Product Specifications

Review the key dimensions and product details before ordering to make sure the sofa fits your room and intended use.

Sofa Dimensions 78.8"L × 39.4"W × 27.5"H

Weight Capacity Up to 1200 lb

Storage 2 Washable Armrest Organizers

Setup Quick Assembly; Allow 48–72 Hours for Full Expansion
Recommended Rooms Living Room, Apartment, Guest Room, Bedroom and Lounge

Frequently Asked Questions

Helpful answers about comfort, dimensions, setup and everyday use.

How does the 5-in-1 convertible design work?

The sofa can be adjusted into multiple configurations for everyday seating, relaxed lounging and sleeping. Reposition the convertible sections and supports to create the setup that best matches your space and activity.

How large is the sofa when fully opened?

In sofa mode, it measures approximately 78.8"L × 39.4"W × 27.5"H. In fully expanded bed mode, it measures approximately 78.8"L × 78.8"W × 19.6"H.

Does the sofa require assembly?

Some setup is required. Unpack the sofa and connect the support and base components according to the included instructions.

How long does the sofa take to expand?

Allow approximately 48–72 hours for the compressed foam and upholstery to recover their intended shape.

Is the sofa soft or firm?

The high-density foam provides a supportive, firmer feel rather than an extremely soft, deep sink-in feel.

What is the maximum weight capacity?

The sofa is designed to support up to 1200 lb when properly assembled and used on a stable, level surface.

What accessories are included?

The package includes two washable armrest organizers, two throw pillows, two L-shaped support pillows, two stainless-steel support frames, two sofa bases and one user manual.

Will this sofa work in a small apartment?

Yes. Its convertible design allows one piece of furniture to function as seating, a lounge area and a guest sleeper. Measure both sofa and bed dimensions before ordering.

How should I clean the corduroy fabric?

Remove loose dust with a soft brush or vacuum attachment. Blot spills with a soft, slightly damp cloth and use mild, fabric-safe cleaners.

More Flexibility from One Piece of Furniture

From daily lounging to overnight guests, this 78.8-inch convertible sleeper sofa combines flexible configurations, supportive comfort and a dark green corduroy finish for modern multipurpose spaces.
